{{Quote|Another group of rocketeers attacked Squad Epsilon. We can't let any of them get away.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rufar]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Squad Epsilon''' was a unit in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The division was stationed in the [[Axial Park]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], where it was attacked by a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] rocket-jumpers.
